As early as you can. For weddings in peak season and on popular muhurtham dates, book 3–4 weeks ahead. Smaller functions can often be arranged within a few days.

faqs.q: Are delivery, set-up and pick-up included?
faqs.a: Yes. Our team delivers, sets up at your venue and collects everything after the event. Transport depends on distance and order size and is included in your quote.

faqs.q: How do I get a price?
faqs.a: Prices depend on items, quantity, date and venue. Send your list on WhatsApp and we'll reply with availability and a quote.

faqs.q: How do I confirm a booking?
faqs.a: A small advance confirms your booking and the balance is paid on or before the event day. We accept cash, UPI and bank transfer.
